rationale: S-0057-01 proposes a sub-0.25 nS finer GABA sweep on t0057 to test a graded-suppression hypothesis below the AMPA-spike-veto threshold. t0059 covers this directly: its GABA_BASE_NS axis includes 0.1 nS and 0.2 nS, both in the sub-veto regime that S-0057-01 targets, on a more biologically realistic per-synapse bar-arrival-locked window mechanism. Rejecting as covered by t0059.
